members.name: PingPong
members.summary: Runs an iterative effect by alternating two targets, and returns the one holding the final result.
members.summaryText: Runs an iterative effect by alternating two targets, and returns the one holding the final result.
examples:
The following example shows how to run four blur passes:

```csharp
var result = Renderer.PingPong(first, second, passes: 4,
    beforePass: (index, input) => Renderer
        .SetShader("Effects/Blur")
        .SetParameter("InputTexture", input)
        .SetParameter("Offset", index + 1f));
```

summary: Draws everything on screen: shader passes, batched shapes, sprites, text and render targets. Every scene and system gets one through its `Renderer` property, and most calls return the renderer so a pass reads as a single chain.
summaryText: Draws everything on screen: shader passes, batched shapes, sprites, text and render targets. Every scene and system gets one through its Renderer property, and most calls return the renderer so a pass reads as a single chain.
examples:
The following example shows how to run a fullscreen shader pass into a render target:

```csharp
Renderer
    .Reset()
    .SetShader("Effects/Blur")
    .Configure(SamplerState.LinearClamp)
    .SetTarget(blurred).Clear(Color.Black)
    .SetParameter("InputTexture", source)
    .SetParameter("BlurRadius", 4f)
    .Draw()
    .Commit();
```

The following example shows how to draw a few shapes and flush them in one draw call:

```csharp
Renderer.DrawRect(new Vector2(40, 40), new Vector2(200, 80), Color.White);
Renderer.DrawCircle(new Vector2(400, 300), 32f, Color.Orange);
Renderer.FlushShapes();
```
